concepts.pain_point: Traders feel isolated and unsure which strategies/ideas to trust without a proven, experienced guide
concepts.core_promise: Free daily trading ideas and option strategies sourced from a 20-year veteran, validated by a massive existing community

synthesized_patterns: Universal 'free' framing as the primary CTA trigger — every ad leads with $0 cost to erase risk/skepticism before pitching a funnel upsell
Authority-by-numbers proof: either dollar figures ($12M in profits) or follower counts (347,500+ traders) are used instead of testimonials or screenshots to establish legitimacy
The core pain point across all ads is FOMO/exclusion — feeling shut out from 'the smart money' or a winning insider community, not lack of trading skill itself
Mentor-figure branding is central: ads are built around a single named veteran trader (Sykes, Bishop) rather than the product/tool itself, personifying trust

Long ad run-times (197-399 days) cluster around evergreen 'free daily alert' offers rather than urgency/scarcity offers, suggesting low-friction free opt-ins outperform hard-sell pitches for top-of-funnel acquisition
CTA consistently routes to a soft, low-commitment action (Learn more/Sign up) rather than 'Buy' or 'Subscribe', reflecting a lead-gen-to-upsell funnel structure common in this niche
